# wallix-bastion_externalauth_saml (Data Source)

Get information about a SAML external authentication configured on the WALLIX Bastion.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing SAML external authentication by name
data "wallix-bastion_externalauth_saml" "corporate" {
  authentication_name = "corporate_saml"
}

# Reference it from an authentication domain mapping
resource "wallix-bastion_authdomain_mapping" "saml_mapping" {
  domain_name = "corporate.local"
  auth_domain = data.wallix-bastion_externalauth_saml.corporate.authentication_name
}

# Output the service provider metadata/URLs needed to configure the identity provider
output "saml_sp_info" {
  value = {
    sp_entity_id                  = data.wallix-bastion_externalauth_saml.corporate.sp_entity_id
    sp_metadata                   = data.wallix-bastion_externalauth_saml.corporate.sp_metadata
    sp_assertion_consumer_service = data.wallix-bastion_externalauth_saml.corporate.sp_assertion_consumer_service
    sp_single_logout_service      = data.wallix-bastion_externalauth_saml.corporate.sp_single_logout_service
    idp_entity_id                 = data.wallix-bastion_externalauth_saml.corporate.idp_entity_id
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `authentication_name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `certificate` (String, Sensitive)
- `claim_customization` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--claim_customization))
- `description` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `idp_entity_id` (String)
- `idp_metadata` (String)
- `passphrase` (String, Sensitive)
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive)
- `saml_request_method` (String)
- `saml_request_url` (String)
- `sp_assertion_consumer_service` (String)
- `sp_entity_id` (String)
- `sp_metadata` (String)
- `sp_single_logout_service` (String)
- `timeout` (Number)

<a id="nestedatt--claim_customization"></a>

### Nested Schema for `claim_customization`

Read-Only:

- `displayname` (String)
- `email` (String)
- `group` (String)
- `language` (String)
- `username` (String)

## Usage Notes

### Lookup Key

`authentication_name` is the only Required argument and is used to look up the SAML external
authentication by its unique name on the Bastion. If no external authentication with that name
exists, the data source returns an error.

### Sensitive Fields Are Never Populated

`certificate`, `passphrase`, and `private_key` are all marked `Sensitive` in the schema because
they can be configured on the resource, but the Bastion API **never returns secret material on
read**. This data source will always report empty values for these fields - do not rely on it to
retrieve the SAML signing certificate's private key or its passphrase. If you need those values in
Terraform, source them from your own secret management system rather than from this data source.

### Other Computed Attributes

- **idp_metadata** / **idp_entity_id**: identity provider metadata and entity ID.
- **sp_metadata** / **sp_entity_id** / **sp_assertion_consumer_service** /
  **sp_single_logout_service**: service provider (Bastion-side) metadata and endpoint URLs -
  useful when configuring the identity provider to trust the Bastion.
- **saml_request_url** / **saml_request_method**: the SSO request URL and HTTP method (e.g.
  `HTTP-POST` or `HTTP-Redirect`) used to initiate authentication.
- **timeout**: authentication timeout, in seconds.
- **description**: free-form description configured on the resource.
- **claim_customization**: block describing how SAML claims are mapped to Bastion user
  attributes (`username`, `displayname`, `email`, `language`, `group`). This block is only
  populated if claim customization was configured on the resource.
